scope.purpose: clean-only raw-IQ physical-control generator foundation and independent validation
protected: CRID C0/C1/C2/C3 settings and handoff PRN map
CRID features, preprocessing, score, H0/H1, predictor, covariance, threshold and gates

sample_contract.source_window_policy: each control input is the exact R0c common interval; output has the same number of complex samples and retains absolute indices in truth
sample_contract.saturation: clip to [-32768,32767] only after measuring excursions

clipping_fail_closed.definition: count of output I or Q scalars outside int16 before clipping divided by 2*complex_sample_count

lineage.nav_semantics: R0b corrected +1 TRACE epoch endpoints, data_symbol_boundary marks end of current bit
lineage.nav_scope: only rows whose corrected absolute raw support contains the requested sample are permitted
lineage.receiver_state: authenticated 1 ms TRACE records used by R0c; action_used code/carrier NCO fields and absolute PRN_start_sample_count
lineage.ca_code: GPS L1 C/A code generated independently for each target PRN

target_assignment.case_order: delay major [0.05,0.15,0.30], then power [-6,-3,0], then mode [single,four]
target_assignment.single: for positive case ordinal k within a domain, target is single_assignment_cycle[k mod 5]
target_assignment.four: for positive case ordinal k within a domain, exclude four_assignment_exclusion_cycle[k mod 5] and target the other four sorted validated PRNs
target_assignment.rationale: outcome-independent lexical rotation covers every validated PRN while preserving exact one/four cardinality

amplitude_estimation.method: per-PRN complex least squares alpha=(s^H x)/(s^H s)
amplitude_estimation.fit_interval: first 1000 complete 1 ms epochs inside the common interval
amplitude_estimation.template: zero-delay authentic PRN C/A*validated-NAV*receiver-NCO carrier replica
amplitude_estimation.multi_prn_fit: all five authenticated templates are fitted jointly before selecting target coefficients
amplitude_estimation.result_use: amplitudes are measurements, never used to choose targets or change frozen parameters

positive_controls.continuity: one absolute-sample formula; code and carrier accumulators are evaluated from absolute TRACE-row origins, never reset at chunks or NAV rows
positive_controls.nav: each target uses its own validated R0c NAV sign; non-targets receive no generated component
positive_controls.physical_effect: one or four coherent PRN-selective delayed replicas smoothly pull from zero to the frozen terminal delay while authentic signals remain
forbidden_shortcuts: shared C/A code or NAV across PRNs

parameters.operation: x + alpha*s_auth*(-2) on epochs whose validated NAV sign is -1 only

controls.effect: bit-dependent sign transformation of one reconstructed PRN, not global pi rotation
3 dB empirical C/N0 reduction by independent noise addition
nonzero code-only ramp of one PRN
nonzero carrier-frequency ramp of one PRN with integrated continuous phase
common nonzero time-base warp without changing sample count
remove primary PRN estimate and add +3 dB secondary PRN component
bounded phase disturbance on exactly one PRN
zero-delay two-source control algebraically collapsed to a gain-like change on one PRN

negative_controls.empirical_noise_sigma: per I/Q component robust sigma = MAD(first_difference(x_component))/(0.6744897501960817*sqrt(2)), evaluated over first 1,000,000 samples of the source window
negative_controls.awgn_prng: NumPy PCG64 seeded by u64be(SHA256(seed+'|'+domain+'|'+control_id)[0:8]); standard_normal pairs generated in one fixed 1,000,000-complex-sample chunk sequence
forbidden_shortcuts: identity implementation of code ramp or clock drift
whole-waveform pi rotation for NAV control
shared delay or phase for independent multipath
describing whole-waveform delay as a PRN-selective replica

truth_sidecar.per_case_json: case metadata, source/output hashes, target set, LS amplitudes, clipping and bounds
truth_sidecar.epoch_binary: little-endian fixed records at 1 ms cadence for absolute sample index, PRN, complex amplitudes, delay, code rate, carrier phase, Doppler, NAV sign and envelope
truth_sidecar.binary_schema: <q i d d d d d d d b 7x
truth_sidecar.inactive_interval: outside the exact R0c source window no file samples exist; within the window envelope truth marks inactive edges

independent_reference.separation: reference correlator is a distinct module and must not import generator render, envelope, delay, phase or injection functions
independent_reference.ca_code: independent shift-register implementation checked against committed PRN chips

tamper_tests: output truncation by one complex sample
